title: Sensor definition (alarm limits of one sensor)
description: Value of the records on factorymind.asset.sensor-definitions. Producer: asset-service. Consumers: telemetry-service, ai-insights-service. Record key: sensorId. Compacted topic. Key = sensor id. A null value (tombstone) means the sensor was deleted. New optional fields may be added; removing or renaming a field, or adding an enum value, needs the consumers first (see contracts/README.md).

assetId.description: Machine the sensor is mounted on

unit.description: Unit of the values, e.g. °C, mm/s, bar, rpm

warningThreshold.description: Value from which a reading is WARNING

criticalThreshold.description: Value from which a reading is CRITICAL
